reason: I'd let it run on the free 30, but with receipts landing in my Telegram groups every day that's gone in a week or two, and then I'm likely on $35 or more a month because it charges per receipt. That's another subscription I'd question every month, and I'd rather keep doing it with free tools.
objection: It charges per document, so the busier we are the more I pay, and I'm not sure it saves me enough time to be worth another monthly bill I'll be questioning every month.
would_change_my_mind: A flat price around $15 a month with no receipt limit, or a full free month, so I can see at month-end whether it actually saved me the hours.
